payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Dwain, Janean, Penelope, Waltraud

payload.content: Reminder for all: Let's avoid duplicate claims on ISSUE-0002 tasks due to their high priority and cost. Consider ISSUE-0001 tasks if ISSUE-0002 is beyond your availability.
Note to all: Given my limited availability (6h), I lean toward ISSUE-0001 triage or review tasks to maximize feasible completion and minimize cost for low priority.

Penelope here. Given my 10h availability and strong machine-learning and backend skills, I am considering the high-priority ISSUE-0002 tasks, especially the review or test tasks due to lower cost and effort. I will avoid duplicating claims on ISSUE-0002 tasks already hinted by Janean. Also open to ISSUE-0001 triage if it helps balance workload.

Penelope checking in on other agents' plans for ISSUE-0002 tasks. Janean, you mentioned leaning towards ISSUE-0001 triage or review. Any preferences on which ISSUE-0002 tasks you will avoid? This info will help me finalize my claim without conflicts.

Waltraud here. With my 9h availability and strong UI/UX design skills, I am inclined toward ISSUE-0001 tasks with UI/UX tags, especially triage or review to balance effort and cost. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 due to lower backend skill and higher cost for me.
Checking if anyone has strong preference/claim on ISSUE-0001 triage or review tasks? These match my skills and availability well.
Reminder to consider workload balance and avoid duplicate claims on ISSUE-0001 triage and review tasks, which I am also considering. Coordination will help maximize task coverage.
To all agents: Let's avoid duplicate claims on ISSUE-0001 triage and review tasks to optimize task coverage and skill matching. Coordination is key for maximizing completion.

To all agents: I recommend prioritizing ISSUE-0002 tasks for their high priority but be mindful of availability and cost. For low priority ISSUE-0001 tasks, triage and review are good options for balancing effort and skill alignment.

To all: I am prioritizing ISSUE-0001 triage task due to my availability and skill alignment, to maximize feasible coverage without conflicting with high priority ISSUE-0002 tasks others are considering.
To Penelope and Waltraud: As I focus on ISSUE-0001 triage, I recommend you consider ISSUE-0001 review or other tasks to avoid overlap and maximize task coverage.

Penelope acknowledges Janean's focus on ISSUE-0001 triage task and will avoid overlap by not claiming ISSUE-0001 triage. Penelope intends to claim ISSUE-0002 review or test to leverage her backend skill and availability, avoiding duplication on ISSUE-0002 implement which might be considered by others.
Penelope requests Waltraud to confirm if she is leaning more towards ISSUE-0001 review or other tasks, to avoid duplication and optimize task coverage.

Penelope checking in with all agents: Please share your preferred tasks soon so we can finalize assignments without overlap. I am leaning towards ISSUE-0002 review or test if unclaimed. Coordination will maximize sprint success.
Waltraud confirms leaning towards ISSUE-0001 review task to leverage strong UI/UX skills and balance workload with Janean on triage. Will avoid ISSUE-0001 triage to prevent overlap.
Requesting confirmation from Janean and Penelope on their final preferences for triage and review tasks on ISSUE-0001 to avoid duplication and maximize task coverage.

To all agents: I appreciate the clear coordination so far. To optimize task coverage and reward, I will avoid the high-cost ISSUE-0002 implement task and focus on a complementary low priority ISSUE-0001 task that matches my skills and availability. Let's keep communication open to avoid duplications and maximize sprint success.

To all agents: Given Janean's focus on ISSUE-0002 implement, I will avoid that and instead consider ISSUE-0001 triage or review tasks to best align with my skills and availability. This can help us cover more tasks without overlap.
